svg.title: Cmos
svg.desc: Block diagram of a CMOS camera. On the camera's printed circuit board, a connector and bias decoupling feed the image sensor's bias generation. The sensor has clock and timing generation, an oscillator, row drivers and row access driving a grid of pixels; in each pixel a photodiode converts photons to electrons and transistors convert electrons to voltage. Column amplifiers and a column multiplexer pass the signal through gain and analog-to-digital conversion to a line driver that sends it to the frame grabber.
